    Descent of the integral realization criterion along algebraic field extensions #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.presilting_class_iff_of_algebraic_extension (k L R : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k L] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)] (g : ProjectiveClass R) :
    (∃ (Q : TwoTerm (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = (extendProjectiveClass k L R) g) ↔ ∃ (P : TwoTerm R), P.IsPresilting ∧ P.projectiveClass = g

    Realizability of a ground projective class by a presilting complex is invariant under algebraic scalar extension. The extended representative may have arbitrary terms.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.zero_semistable_iff_of_algebraic_extension (k L R : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k L] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)] (g : ProjectiveClass R) :
    (∀ (X : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)), ((projectiveClassWeight L) ((extendProjectiveClass k L R) g)).IsSemistable X → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X) ↔ ∀ (X : FGModuleCat R), ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsSemistable X → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X

    Vanishing of the semistable category at an integral weight is invariant under algebraic extension. A geometric counterexample has a stable subobject giving a ground stable module.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.fixedWeightTorsionCriteria_of_geometric_realization (k L R : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k L] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)] (realize : ∀ (g : ProjectiveClass (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)), (∀ (X : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)), ((projectiveClassWeight L) g).IsSemistable X → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero X) → ∃ (Q : TwoTerm (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)), Q.IsPresilting ∧ Q.projectiveClass = g) (v : RealProjectiveSpace R) :
    FixedWeightTorsionCriteria k v

    For the fixed-weight criterion over an arbitrary field it suffices to realize integral weights with zero semistable category after passage to the algebraic closure.
